notes.text:
This update for mariadb-connector-c fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-44172: mysql_real_escape_string() incorrectly handled big5 (bsc#1266438).

Changes for mariadb-connector-c:

- Update to 3.1.28.

In versions 3.3.18 and 3.4.8, an application that was taking non-validated user input, escaping it with mysql_real_escape_string() and sending it to the database using text protocol and big5 character set was vulnerable to SQL injections, even though mysql_real_escape_string() was supposed to prevent them. This issue has been patched in versions 3.3.19 and 3.4.9.
